examined_formations.title: CPG_RETAIL_DEDUCTION_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: CPG 零售扣款自动追偿
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current production engineering role describes a live B2B product for paying CPG brands that ingests deduction events from portals/EDI/email, assembles evidence, validates claims, files disputes, and reconciles outcomes. The business physics are excellent, but multiple current deduction-recovery platforms already occupy the same full loop.

examined_formations.title: ECOMMERCE_CHARGEBACK_EVIDENCE_AND_SUBMISSION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 电商拒付证据拼装与自动提交
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current merchants pay recurring specialists to collect order, tracking and communication evidence and submit Stripe/PayPal/Shopify disputes. The event and evidence are machine-readable, but Shopify already auto-populates evidence and adds AI insights, while dedicated automation and productized AI-dispute services already submit responses automatically.

examined_formations.title: SUBCONTRACTOR_COI_EXPIRY_AND_RENEWAL_CHASING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 分包商保险证书到期与续期追踪
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current construction operations pay people to chase COIs, W-9s, expirations and renewals on a recurring basis. The trigger is deterministic and machine-readable, but numerous exact COI platforms already collect, grade, remind and monitor this workflow.

examined_formations.title: FREIGHT_INVOICE_ACCESSORIAL_AUDIT_AND_DISPUTE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 运费发票附加费审计与争议
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Freight teams pay for invoice audit, accessorial-error detection and carrier follow-up. Rate agreements, BOL/POD, dock timestamps and invoices form a strong machine state, but current freight-audit products already compare every invoice to contracts and can send evidence-backed disputes.

examined_formations.title: CONSTRUCTION_LIEN_WAIVER_PAYMENT_GATE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 建筑留置权豁免付款门禁
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current $6,500 construction billing engagement pays for lien-waiver sequencing and portal procedures. Payment events are machine-readable, but multiple 2026 products already generate, send, sign, track and payment-gate lien waivers at low SaaS prices.

examined_formations.title: CHANNEL_MDF_COOP_REIMBURSEMENT_CLAIMS
examined_formations.chinese_title: 渠道 MDF / Co-op 营销基金报销申领
examined_formations.evidence_summary: MDF/co-op funds create real expiring reimbursement entitlements with proof-of-performance and claim deadlines, but Salesforce, ZINFI, xAmplify, e2open and rebate-management platforms already manage allocation, evidence, claims, approvals and settlement.
